name: AgentKey
description: Connect AgentKey to access live web, social, market, e-commerce, and company data.
authorization.title: Authorize an AgentKey account
authorization.description: Sign in on the official AgentKey page. POCO uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, so you do not need to paste an API key.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.web.title: Web search and extraction
capabilities.web.description: Search the web and news, and extract public content from a specified URL.
capabilities.social.title: Social media data
capabilities.social.description: Query public data from RED, X, Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, and other platforms.
capabilities.market.title: Financial and market data
capabilities.market.description: Query stocks, foreign exchange, crypto assets, on-chain data, and related market information.
capabilities.business.title: E-commerce and company data
capabilities.business.description: Query public product, price, review, company, funding, and people data.
examples.title: Examples
examples.social.title: Analyze social trends
examples.social.description: Find and summarize popular AI office-tool content from the last seven days, then suggest newsletter or short-video angles.
examples.finance.title: Analyze market reactions
examples.finance.description: Combine market prices and news to explain the reaction to NVIDIA's latest earnings report.
examples.commerce.title: Compare products
examples.commerce.description: Search Taobao, JD, and 1688 for Bluetooth earbuds and compare prices and customer reviews.
examples.github.title: Discover trending projects
examples.github.description: Find GitHub projects that became popular in the last 30 days and summarize their purpose, stars, and use cases.
configuration.endpoint.label: MCP endpoint
configuration.endpoint.description: The official AgentKey Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Keep the default value.
